title: Lively Citrusy Syrian Shrimp Pilaf
description: A dense and festive Syrian dish featuring shrimp paste and dum, perfect for special occasions, and diabetic-friendly due to its balanced ingredients and portion control.
instructions: Heat the dum in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the shrimp paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the basmati rice and stir to coat the rice with the shrimp paste mixture.
Add the orange and lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in the chopped parsley and scallions.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley and scallions if desired.
Refrigerate or freeze leftovers for up to 3 days.
Reheat the pilaf in the microwave or on the stovetop, adding a little water if necessary.
